arms.A_time_series: pooled + per-asset Spearman(dfh_pct, ret5); raw-dfh20 pooled Spearman (T101 comp); Welch dfh_pct>=0.90 vs rest and >=0.80 vs <=0.20 (T101 comp)
arms.B_cross_section: per day (all 5 symbols) rank by raw dfh20; spread fwd_5d(top1)-fwd_5d(bot1) bps; top2/bot2 variant alongside; mean daily spread t + pooled Welch + per-year folds. THIN: 5 assets, half the T104 cohort
arms.C_spec_gate: funding_pct>=0.80 AND basis_pct>=0.66 AND BTC-up: gate-on vs gate-off Welch + inside-gate Spearman(dfh20,ret5) + median-split dfh_pct Welch (T101 A1c analog)

cohort.fetch_manifest: data/venue_perp_v1/bybit/fetch_manifest.json (hash-pinned fetch, licence UNVERIFIED; offline non-commercial research only)
cohort.series: kline daily close (price series for dfh + labels); mark daily close (basis + robustness cell); index daily close (basis); funding 8h settlements, last of UTC day = f_last

definitions.basis_pct: trailing-180 mid-rank pct of (mark/index-1)*1e4 — full basis-equivalent available, no funding+trend-only deviation needed
definitions.dfh_pct: trailing-180 mid-rank pct of dfh20 per symbol, window excludes decision row
definitions.eval_range: i in [180, n-5) per symbol, all inputs non-null

purpose: External replication of the dfh effects on a second venue (Bybit), same play as T99 on Hyperliquid. References: T101 time-series pooled rho=+0.031 (FDR-pass) and T104 10-asset XS top2-bot2 +54.06bps/day (t=3.344), both Binance. Measurement only — no fitting, no trading, no profitability claims.

caveats: 5d labels on 1d bars overlap ~5x; pooled rows share the market factor across assets — p-values nominal/optimistic
5-asset cross-section is VERY thin: top1-vs-bot1 = 2 effective obs/day; top2-vs-bot2 covers 80% of the cohort and is not a real extremes contrast
Bybit eval span (~2023-07 onward after the 180d warm-up) only partly overlaps the Binance reference window (2023-01-25..2026-08-30)
kline close is last-trade close, not mark; quantified by the mark-series robustness cell
gross moves only — no fees, spread, slippage, funding cashflows
statistics.daily_t: mean/sd/t across decision days + normal-approx p (nominal — overlapping labels)
statistics.spearman: mid-rank rho + normal-approx t/p, min n=10
statistics.welch: Welch t on fwd log returns in bps, normal-approx two-sided p, min n=10 per side

verdict_rule: per cell: replicated iff sign agrees with the Binance reference AND BH-FDR pass; cells below the n needed to detect the reference rho at nominal p<0.05 are labelled low_power rather than not_replicated; honest negative reporting
